content.short: Rip.xyz is a Hyperliquid vault platform issuing tokenized yield positions such as rHYPE.
content.description: Rip.xyz runs vault strategies on Hyperliquid and issues the resulting positions as tokens, so a depositor holds something transferable rather than a locked balance. Tokenising the position is what lets it be used elsewhere as collateral, which is usually worth more than the marginal yield difference between vaults.
content.meta: Vault positions issued as tokens, so they can be used as collateral elsewhere.
